metadata.gitb:name: FHIR server smoke test
metadata.gitb:description: A simple smoke test against a FHIR R4 server, exercising three core capabilities: 1. CapabilityStatement — server publishes /metadata 2. Create — POST /Patient returns 201 with a server-assigned id 3. Read — GET /Patient/{id} round-trips the resource Reference profile: base FHIR R4 Patient http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Patient
